transport: RS-485 over RJ45 · Modbus RTU · 9600 bps, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit · slave ID 0x01, stated fixed · function code 0x03 only (read holding registers), 1–125 registers per request · RJ45 pins 1=B-, 2=A+, 6=GND, 7=A+, 8=B- · 120 Ω terminator on the master side only, inverter is internally terminated · GND must be bonded master-to-inverter
blocks: regs 3–7 serial number (10 ASCII chars, 2 per register) · regs 60–114 running data, energy totals and temperatures · regs 103–106 fault bitfield (4 words = 64 bits, one bit per fault code F08…F64) · regs 150–196 real-time AC / battery / PV / relay data

unmappedReports: Directional grid energy: Day Grid Buy (reg 76), Day Grid Sell (77), Total Grid Buy (78 low / 80 high), Total Grid Sell (81 low / 82 high). MetricKind has ac-energy-today and ac-energy-total but neither carries an import/export direction, so buy and sell would collide., Battery energy throughput: Day Batt Charge (70), Day Batt Discharge (71), Total Batt Charge (72/73), Total Batt Discharge (74/75). No battery-energy-charged / battery-energy-discharged kind exists., Load energy: Day Load Power Wh (84), Total Load Power Wh (85/86). load-power is instantaneous only; there is no load-energy-today / load-energy-total., Per-leg L1/L2 split of everything: grid voltage L1-N/L2-N (150/151), inverter output voltage L1-N/L2-N (154/155), load voltage L1/L2 (157/158), grid current L1/L2 (160/161), inverter output current L1/L2 (164/165), grid power L1/L2 (167/168), inverter output power L1/L2 (173/174), load power L1/L2 (176/177), load current L1/L2 (179/180). MetricKind has no phase or leg dimension — a split-phase inverter's per-leg imbalance is exactly what a cabin owner wants to see and there is nowhere to put it., Line-to-line voltage: grid L1-L2 (152), relay mid-point L1-L2 (153), inverter output L1-L2 (156), gen port L1-L2 (181). No ac-voltage-line-to-line kind., Three distinct AC power domains that MetricKind cannot separate: grid-side total (169, signed, >0 buy / <0 sell), inverter output total (175) and load-side total (178). Only ac-power and load-power exist, so grid flow and inverter output would both have to be ac-power., External CT / "Limiter" channels: limiter current L1/L2 (162/163), limiter power CT1/CT2 (170/171), limiter total power (172). No ct-power or grid-limiter metric., Generator / AC-coupled port electricals: gen or AC-coupled power input (166, sign encodes load-output vs AC-input), gen port voltage (181), generator relay frequency (196). MetricKind has generator-run-state, -run-hours, -start-count and -fuel-remaining but no generator voltage, current, power or frequency., Generator-side relay status (195): 0 open, 1 closed, 2 no connection, 3 closed-when-generator-on. RunState (stopped/starting/running/stopping/faulted/unknown) has no "not connected" and no "conditionally closed" state, so this cannot round-trip., Grid-side relay status (194): 1 open / 2 closed. switch-state is a plain Boolean with switch semantics; there is no grid-relay-state or grid-connected kind., Two distinct inverter-internal temperatures — DC/DC transformer (90) and IGBT heat sink (91) — both collapse onto the generic `temperature` kind. No inverter-temperature / heatsink-temperature to tell them apart on one device., 64-bit fault bitfield (103–106), 30-odd documented codes F08…F64 with vendor-written remediation text. There is no fault-code or active-faults MetricKind; ChargeStage::Fault is the only fault surface in the contract and it is a solar-charger concept, not an inverter one. CommandKind::ClearFault exists with nothing to report against., Corrected Batt Capacity in Ah (107). Unit::AmpHour exists but there is no battery-capacity MetricKind — consumed-amp-hours is a different quantity., Three separate frequencies: grid frequency (79), load frequency (192), inverter output frequency (193). Only one ac-frequency., Inverter serial number (regs 3–7, 10 ASCII chars). Identity rather than telemetry, but worth noting there is no channel for it.
